subtitle: Sebenzisa wonke umugqa kanye
short_description: Hlela indlela esebenzisa wonke amaxhumanisi kanye.
description: Sebenzisa wonke amaxhumanisi abonakalayo kanye kuphela. Ungavakashela amachashaza, futhi izinqamuko ezingenachashaza akuyona amaxhumano. Xazulula amagrafu amasha angu-8 ngokulandelela noma ngokuthepha izinkinobho ezinkulu zamachashaza. Hlehlisa, qala kabusha, vakashela amabhodi angaphambili, futhi uqhubeke nomzila wakho wasendaweni nenqubekelaphambili evuliwe.
